page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred black-letter-free roman and italic lines top to bottom; no running head; handwritten page number "37" top right is not printed and is left out; faint library stamp and shelf mark lower left left out.

l.i: Viri admodùm Reverendi, Clarissimi atq; Doctissimi,
Acutissimi, Præceptoris sui nullo non Honore
Ad diem 25. May, horis locoq; solitis.

page.notes: The Greek line reads "Θεῷ παντοκράτορος" in the usual formula; the printed form is as shown and may be doubtful. The date is printed MDCLXXVI (1676). Handwritten "37" at top right and the pencilled catalogue number and library stamp at the foot are not printed text and are omitted; the word "Quam" and the Greek line are set in italic script.
